# Introduction

In this report we are going to inspect a data base related with a satisfaction survey.

# Import data

In this section were are going to import and transform the data to show descriptive statistics.

```{r}
#| message: false
satisfaction_data <- read_csv(
    file = "http://goo.gl/UDv12g"
)
```

# Summarize data

Pending

```{r}
satisfaction_data <- satisfaction_data |>
    mutate(
        Segment = factor(
            x = Segment,
            ordered = FALSE
        )
    )

satisfaction_data |>
    skim()
```
